fullPassage: Research findings can inject life into an idea in a way that helps us to appreciate its significance and plausibility. In this sense, research in the social sciences can function like photographs in journalism. They move us to consider a point of view. My introduction to Skinnerian reinforcement theory was just of this sort. Although prepared to resist the theory on intellectual and political grounds, as I watched the professor use food pellets to bring the random movements of a pigeon under his control, I couldn't escape the power of the behaviourist perspective. Its plausibility will always remain with me. By the same token, Piaget's famous experiments with children's problem-solving do not furnish us with the truth about human development. However, they draw our attention to significant alternatives to behaviourism in understanding children's learning.

✅ ① photographs in journalism (or research in the social sciences): 바로 앞 문장의 비유 대상. 사진과 연구 모두 관점을 고려하게 움직임.
❌ ② the author and other scholars: 글쓴이가 포함된 'They'는 사진이 아닌 다른 관점.
❌ ③ Skinnerian theories: 특정 이론이 아닌 일반적 연구/사진.
❌ ④ pigeons in behaviourist experiments: 비둘기는 이후 등장.
det.tip: They = 사진 + 연구 (병렬 비유 대상).

questions.passage: Research findings can inject life into an idea in a way that helps us to appreciate its significance and plausibility. In this sense, research in the social sciences can function like photographs in journalism. They move us to consider a point of view. My introduction to Skinnerian reinforcement theory was just of this sort. Although prepared to resist the theory on intellectual and political grounds, as I watched the professor use food pellets to bring the random movements of a pigeon under his control, I couldn't escape the power of the behaviourist perspective. Its plausibility will always remain with me. By the same token, Piaget's famous experiments with children's problem-solving do not furnish us with the truth about human development. However, <u>they</u> draw our attention to significant alternatives to behaviourism in understanding children's learning.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>they</u>가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ the well-known studies conducted by Piaget: 앞 문장의 피아제 실험들을 지칭.
❌ ① significant alternatives: 대안은 실험이 끌어내는 대상.
❌ ② children doing problem-solving: 아이들은 실험 대상.
❌ ③ researchers who study behaviourism: 본문에 나오지 않음.
det.tip: they = 피아제의 유명한 실험들(복수 명사구).
